name: flow-2034
notes: Regression check, part 1 of 2 (user, 2026-10-21: one or two runs with many observations, not a pass of many probes). The natural game from the 2034 save for a year, nothing injected: alien economy (mine what you lack, exotics cap, war chest, no Earth purchases, widening), proxy trade, raids and captures, attack sizing, fleet mix, contempt; human AI (fixes H1/H2/H4-H6, MC plan, queue fixes, market, drain guard, personalities). Asserts are health checks and wide regression guards; judge balance by soaks, not one run. Feature probes with injected setups (e1, e5, doctrines, shame, fleet doctrines, terminus, war chest) stay for the feature being changed.
asserts: all(not e['habs'] and e['controlPoints'] == 0 and e['orgs'] == 0 for e in events('trade'))
info: [(e['t'][:7], e['bases'], e['cap'], round(e['drip'], 1), round(e['upkeep'], 1), e['stock']['Exotics'], e.get('warChest'), e.get('largeFactor')) for e in events('economy')][::3]
median([r['scv'] / r['defThreat'] for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet') if r.get('defThreat')] or [0])
(count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True, winner='AlienCouncil'))
(count('trade', to='AlienCouncil'), sum(e['resources'].get('Metals', 0) for e in events('trade', to='AlienCouncil')))
[(f['faction'], round(f['contempt'], 2)) for f in events('disposition')[-1]['factions']] if count('disposition') else None

{f: (faction(first, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('ships')) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
{r: count('human-market', ok=True, resource=r) for r in ['Metals', 'NobleMetals', 'Water']}

{f: (faction(first, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(first, f).get('stations', 0), faction(last, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(last, f).get('stations', 0)) for f in ['ResistCouncil'] + ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
